message: 恋は煩い、皆うるさい

name: Riesling
message: 「Well then, my lady. Have a safe trip.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes♪ Thank you, Jiiya.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte. Have a good day.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, I'm off♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah...! That's right. You should use this guidebook as a reference and go see all sorts of places in the Human World.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Eh... ah, yes...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Lolotte. Morning!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah. Good morning, Mr. President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning to you too, Amyrina.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Ah... g-good morning...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「Seeing her off with Riesling?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-Yes!\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. It'd be nice if you transferred in too, Amyrina, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooooh!! That might just be a brilliant idea!」

name: Synn
message: 「If we ask Helena, maybe she could pull some strings?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「U-Um. Th-That's--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Once it's decided, no time like the present~!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, you two!! Over there, over there!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on! You're causing a disturbance for the students in a place like this!」

name: Ria
message: 「Anyway... okay? Stop crying--」

name: Arden
message: 「Sniff, sob... Shut up, old hag!!」

name: Misa
message: 「How dare you do that to my dear sister!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan...」

name: Misa
message: 「If you insult my sister, I won't forgive you!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Um, so you're not going to deny it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me, coming through~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, well, Arden-san. Did you come back to get beaten up again without learning your lesson?」

name: Arden
message: 「*Hic*, *sniff*... ngh. I lost... There's no making excuses for it now.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're surprisingly graceful in defeat.」

name: Synn
message: 「First of all, why did you attack us in the first place?」

name: Arden
message: 「Since when do you need a reason to fight?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you're one of the Seven Demon Generals, so don't you have some strong convictions?」

name: Arden
message: 「W-Well... I wouldn't say I don't...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I knew it. As expected of one of the Seven Demon Generals, you're totally different from other demons.」

name: Arden
message: 「S-Stop it, you.\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「Just the other day, I met another one of the Seven Demon Generals, and they gave off the same kind of vibe.」

name: Arden
message: 「N-No way, was it Soltia or Bylous...? If it was, heh. Well, that's not bad at all.」
I don't know who they are, but it's probably best not to mention it was Eauderourke.

name: Arden
message: 「You're--uhh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I'm Synn Sakura, the Student Council President.」

name: Arden
message: 「O-Oh, right. In deference to your spirit as president, I'll tell you all about my magnificent convictions.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~」

name: Arden
message: 「Word has it that you guys in the Student Council have been bullying a certain girl.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Who on earth could it be? Someone who would do such a wicked thing!」

name: Arden
message: 「Apparently they're working her to the bone at some shop called Prier.」

name: Synn
message: 「At Prier...?」

name: Arden
message: 「And on top of that, seems like you lot became Crusaders and have been getting in the way all over the place.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You make it sound as though we're the villains here.」

name: Arden
message: 「Which is why I've stepped up like this to protect that girl!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And what exactly are you to this girl, Mr. Arden?」

name: Arden
message: 「W-Well, that's... S-Stop it\s03 That's embarrassing, y'know?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Th-That's... plainly what they call unrequited love!!」

name: Arden
message: 「Idiot!! It's mutual, I tell ya!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa~~ How wonderful~~\s04」

name: Arden
message: 「I could die for that girl!!」
I see. So Lolotte is interested in romance too...

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, hey, Lolotte--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Devoting yourself to the one you love, even at the cost of your own body. I admire that~~\s07 Don't you agree, Mr. President♪」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see... So that's the kind of thing Lolotte is into.」

name: Arden
message: 「Right? So, Student Council! Let me beat you nice and clean!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Unfortunately, we cannot do that.」

name: Arden
message: 「Please!! I'm begging you!! Groveling!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Ew, so lame. You're one of the Seven Demon Generals, don't you have any pride?」

name: Arden
message: 「Huh!? What was that!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, well, if it isn't Ms. Extra.」

name: Arden
message: 「O-Oh... What's this\s03 Sh-She's kinda cute, ain't she...」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaat?!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, Prez!! What's with that reaction?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right!! Losing your head over another girl--and a mere child like Bonus-san, no less--cheating is a crime!!」

name: Arden
message: 「Kuhah!! My bad, my bad. What's gotten into me, getting dazzled by a woman other than Pasta-chan.」

name: Sally
message: 「C'mon, Prez♪ Sally-chan's gonna knock you dead with her sexy beam.\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh--?! Bonus-san, please stop doing weird things!」

name: Sally
message: 「Why're you getting in the way, Lolo-chi!」

name: Synn
message: 「Both of you, stop!! Just now, Arden said Pasta...」

name: Sally
message: 「Italian food?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Pasta... san?」

name: Arden
message: 「You bet! When you talk about Pasta-chan, she's the idol of the Demon Generals. One of the Seven Demon Generals, just like me!」

name: Sally
message: 「For the record, I'm the idol of the Demon World♪」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's not what I mean! Speaking of Pasta, you know... from Prier.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aaaah!! The waitress!!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way... Pasta was a demon?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I didn't notice at all...」

name: Sally
message: 「What, Lolo-chi, you didn't know? How lame.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you noticed, please tell me!! I'll sue you for breach of trust!!」

name: Synn
message: 「So that means we got in Pasta's way, and Arden got mad about it and attacked us.」

name: Synn
message: 「Pasta!!」

name: Arden
message: 「Uooooh, Pasta-chan! Could those bags be a homemade meal just for me?!」

name: Pasta
message: 「No, nya!! It's my first errand, nyan! This is for Prier--」

name: Pasta
message: 「Wait, this is no time to be working seriously, nyan! Arden!! What is the meaning of this, nya!!」

name: Arden
message: 「I came to beat up the Student Council for your sake, Pasta-chan!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though you're the one who got beaten up, Arden-san.」

name: Arden
message: 「Please! Keep that a secret!」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't need to keep the fact that you're a demon a secret?」

name: Arden
message: 「Yeah, that part's okay!」

name: Pasta
message: 「That's the top-secret part, nya!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Idiot Arden! Pasta went to all the trouble of sneaking in undercover... All the patience up till now has gone down the drain, nyan!」

name: Arden
message: 「I see, Pasta-chan.... It's all the Student Council's fault, isn't it.」

name: Pasta
message: 「It's your fault for being way too stupid, nya!!」

name: Arden
message: 「D-Don't say something so cruel~~\s06」

name: Pasta
message: 「The operation is a failure now, nyan!! All the hard work up till now is ruined, nyan! Mooo~~~ At this rate, Bylous-nyama is going to hate me, nyan!」

name: Arden
message: 「B-Bylous, you say?! I'm way cooler than a guy like him!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Idiot Arden!! Idiot Arden!! Bylous-nyama is obviously the best, nyan!!」

name: Arden
message: 「Uooooh, stop calling me an idiot!」

name: Synn
message: 「What even is this.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm... This is what they call a pair of lovey-dovey idiots.\s04」

name: Arden
message: 「S-Stop it, you.\s03」

name: Pasta
message: 「We are definitely not a couple, nya!! Pasta's maiden heart is already battered to pieces, nya...」

name: Pasta
message: 「I'm quitting Prier already, nya!!」

name: Arden
message: 「N-No way... Reconsider! I want to see more of Pasta-chan in her waitress outfit!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Everyone! Assemble, assemble, nya!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!! There's a ton of demons!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「All-out attack on Arden, nya!!」

name: Arden
message: 「W-Whoa! S-Stop it--!」

name: Pasta
message: 「And so, I've been in your care to a nauseating degree, nya.」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of 'and so' is that...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please make good use of this experience and do your best at your next shop, okay.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Ginyaaa!! I'm never doing something like being a Waitress ever again, nyan!! I'm going home!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Commanding that many Demons... She really was a Demon General...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What a surprise~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I wonder why Pasta snuck into this academy in the first place.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is, surely... love!」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Love...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「For Bylous-nyama-nyama, like whether she loves him or hates him.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I see.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's what you call a love romance...\s04」
W-What's going on. Lolotte has been super interested in love affairs for a while now.

name: Arden
message: 「Ugh... That was awful...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You got dumped spectacularly, didn't you.」

name: Sally
message: 「Pfft, how uncool~」

name: Arden
message: 「Shut up! Shut up! Shut up!」

name: Arden
message: 「Damn it. To think she'd be head over heels for a guy like that...」

name: Arden
message: 「Still, with that guy, looks are about the only thing he's got me beat on... Tch! How am I supposed to get Pasta-chan to turn her head my way!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, cheer up already.」

name: Arden
message: 「Oh! Right! I've got you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Arden
message: 「Heh heh heh. If these guys pitch in, I might even be able to beat that Bylous to a pulp.」

name: Arden
message: 「Thanks for cheering me up! In return for that kindness, I, the lone wolf Arden, will lend you guys a hand!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Truly, this is the power of love!!」

name: Arden
message: 「I-In exchange, though! When I'm in a pinch, you'd better come save me, got it?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What should we do, President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I think it's fine. It's way better than having him cause trouble.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then it'll depend on the time and place.」

name: Arden
message: 「Yeah, looking forward to working with you!」
Arden joined the party!

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, not bad at all. Taming a wild beast like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, Helena...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Right. Even the 'King' of Beasts doesn't stand a chance. Yes, yes, that's the Synn-chan I know.」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's...」

name: Helena
message: 「Here's a present for you♪」

name: Helena
message: 「I know, you know. How hard you've been working to keep the peace at the academy. I've been watching the whole time.」

name: Helena
message: 「'Hmph, I see through everything'」
Sometimes, I can't help feeling like this joke might actually be true.
